reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: 01e property (outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json line 678): 'Blobs from local EL that skip KZG verification must still produce valid data columns.' Code reading is accurate: message_router.nim:115-131 validates blobs ONLY for Deneb/Electra forks, Fulu path (L155-193) broadcasts data columns without prior blob KZG validation. However, this is BY DESIGN per the trust model. BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json explicitly states Engine API is JWT-authenticated and SEMI_TRUSTED, with 'blobs from local EL skip cryptographic verification.' The trust assumption document notes 'attacks requiring a compromised local EL may be considered conditional or lower severity.' The validator flow (beacon_validators.nim:587-589) receives blobs from engineBlock.blobsBundle (local EL), passes them to assemble_data_column_sidecars without validation, which is the INTENDED trust boundary. This is not a vulnerability—it is a documented design choice where local EL is trusted via JWT authentication. Phase 03 flagged spec-compliant behavior.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: 01e PROP-6a4369e9-asm-002 and asm-003 explicitly document this trust model: Engine API is JWT-authenticated, blobs from local EL skip KZG verification. BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json confirms this is the intended trust boundary.
